Lorem Ipsum Generator

Generate classic lorem ipsum placeholder text by paragraphs, words or sentences for your designs, mockups and wireframes in one click.

Click Generate to create lorem ipsum text...

📖 How to use

  1. Enter how much text you need.
  2. Choose paragraphs, words or sentences.
  3. Click Generate to create the text.
  4. Copy it or download it as a .txt file.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is lorem ipsum?

Lorem ipsum is scrambled Latin placeholder text used by designers since the 1500s to show how a layout looks before real content is ready.

Can I generate a specific number of words?

Yes. Choose "words" from the type dropdown and enter any number between 1 and 5000.

Is the generated text random?

Each generation shuffles classic lorem ipsum sentences, so you get a fresh variation every time you click Generate.
